flow_name: Dashboard 360 Account Inquiry, Quick Access & Operational Metrics

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Authenticated landing -> Verify Dashboard 360 header and navigation -> Inspect Accounts donut chart widget -> Explore Quick Access links -> Verify Total Due -> Inspect Orders and Support Tickets widgets -> Inspect Popular Solutions carousel -> Conclude session via Profile Menu -> Sign Out.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Real-time billing engines and ticketing backends provide read-only feed data.

canonical_steps.action: Verify the authenticated B2B Portal Dashboard 360 loads successfully
canonical_steps.expected_result: The top navigation bar is visible with links for Dashboard, Manage, Pay, Order, Services, and Support

canonical_steps.action: Verify the active organizational context and Cost Centers dropdown
canonical_steps.expected_result: Organization name is displayed alongside active Cost Centers and the Search Accounts search bar

canonical_steps.action: Inspect the ACCOUNTS widget displaying active service summaries and donut chart
canonical_steps.expected_result: Active accounts breakdown is displayed with total count and category distribution

canonical_steps.action: Verify the QUICK ACCESS navigation card options
canonical_steps.expected_result: Quick access links are present for Buy Fixed Service, Manage my Companies, Pay Accounts, Technical Support, and Get Premium Support

canonical_steps.action: Inspect the TOTAL DUE widget displaying account billing balance
canonical_steps.expected_result: The widget shows current balance or confirmation that all bills are paid up to date

canonical_steps.action: Verify the POPULAR SOLUTIONS section showcasing enterprise packages
canonical_steps.expected_result: Popular solution cards for Business landline, Business Internet Plans, and Care Plus are interactively displayed

canonical_steps.action: Open the user profile menu and sign out of the portal
canonical_steps.expected_result: User session is invalidated, and the browser redirects to the login screen
